query: Which statistical methods most effectively propagate per-pixel classification probabilities through InVEST and RUSLE into decision-ready confidence intervals for county officials?

response.query: Which statistical methods most effectively propagate per-pixel classification probabilities through InVEST and RUSLE into decision-ready confidence intervals for county officials?
response.answer: Bayesian inference and bootstrapping effectively propagate per-pixel classification probabilities through InVEST and RUSLE into decision-ready confidence intervals for county officials. These methods provide robust interval estimation and coverage probability.
